newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal spreads seen narrowing with Bund.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal spreads seen narrowing with Bund.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of four banks and one brokerage.
Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

-The 10-years seen gaining slightly in line with Spain as investors gain in confidence that new French government will not take a soft line on the budget. Despite expectations that 10-year Portuguese auction on Tuesday will see higher rates, market remains well-supported. Little chance of steepening of curve as Bank of Portugal seen holding rates steady when announces new money market terms on Tuesday.
